experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: My professional journey in tech companies
experience.heynow_desc: Leading Uruguayan AI company specializing in artificial intelligence solutions with over 250 clients in Latin America, the Caribbean, North America, and Europe, focusing on process automation and AI-powered virtual agents. I started as a Front-End Architect, leading the product redesign and scaling the front-end architecture on Angular, Docker, and Microsoft Azure. I then evolved into a Full Stack AI Developer, expanding my scope to encompass the complete development of the various platforms that comprise the suite, including the agent-to-agent (A2A) communication infrastructure.
experience.liberasoft_desc: Argentinian company with over 20 years of experience developing a modular cloud ERP for business management in SMEs and large companies, with modules for sales, purchasing, inventory, accounting, WMS, and AI-powered automation. My seven years there reflect continuous evolution: I started as a Front-End Developer building interfaces with Angular and PrimeNG, progressed to Senior Front-End Developer leading the development and architecture of the ERP's frontend, then expanded to Full Stack Developer adding Node.js, MySQL, and MongoDB for developing the platform's various modules and integrated applications. Finally, as an AI Integration Developer, I incorporated artificial intelligence capabilities into the product, integrating n8n for process automation, Python for data collection, and RAG for generative AI functionalities applied to the business.
